description: July 22 birthday meaning: Cancer or Leo cusp, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, July 22 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Cancer or Leo. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The July 22 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: The final degree of Cancer belongs to July 22nd in most years, yet depending on birth year and time the Sun may already be in Leo. Master number 22, the builder, kept unreduced, adds scale. The cusp blend pairs protective care with a wish to shine, often read as someone who builds lasting things for the people they love.

Astronomically, July 22 puts the Sun near 29° Cancer in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. Around July 21 to July 23, the Sun moves from Cancer, a water sign, into Leo, a fire sign. Born near that line, your Sun sign hangs on the exact year, time and birthplace, because the crossing does not happen at the same moment each July. A chart cast for your details will settle which side you are on. Astrologers often say people on this cusp combine lunar sensitivity with solar warmth and confidence. That blend can look like a protective host: someone who wants to be seen, and wants everyone in the room to feel safe.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for July 22
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a July 22 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 33 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous July 22 birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 22 is the 203rd day of the year (204th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Leo, is usually complete within 1 day, by July 23.

By July 22 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a July 22 birthday are Selena Gomez (1992), Gustav Ludwig Hertz (1887) and Willem Dafoe (1955).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 22?
faq.answer: July 22 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Cancer or Leo on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Cancer. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 22 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 33 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 22?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 22, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 22?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on July 22 include Selena Gomez (1992), Gustav Ludwig Hertz (1887) and Willem Dafoe (1955). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
